item.title: Google Drive
item.description:
The Google Drive connection is rolling out. It needs a Layer5 Cloud release that includes it, so you may not see it on a Layer5 Cloud deployment that has not been updated yet. The connection screens are still being finished, so the steps below describe each step in general terms rather than quoting button labels.

A Google Drive connection lets Layer5 Cloud fetch media files that you pick from your Google Drive. Your files stay in your Drive. Layer5 does not copy them into long-term storage.
